第83章 踢到钛合金板，茶楼的设想！-《重生2000：撕了协议我暴富了》

沈俊峰的笑僵在脸上。

陈怀民站在银色保时捷旁，手里还端着咖啡。

“来，讲讲。”

场子里的声音低了下去。

刚才沈俊峰把话说得太满。

发动机，底盘，调校，传承。

现在陈怀民只问一个涡轮型号，已经算给他留面子。

沈俊峰站在车边，喉咙动了动。

“993TUrbOS嘛，双涡轮……”

陈怀民点头。

“废话不用讲。涡轮型号。”

沈俊峰卡住了。

有人低头喝咖啡，有人干脆把烟掐了。

顾城靠在一台宾利旁边，忍笑忍得肩膀直动。

沈俊峰撑了几秒。

“这种老车配置很多，欧洲版、美规版都不一样，没必要抠这么细吧？”

陈怀民把咖啡放到工具台上。

“刚才不是你自己说的？”

他拍了拍车顶。

“真懂车，要讲发动机、底盘、调校。”

“现在问你涡轮，你跟我聊版本。”

“沈少，你这传承传到哪儿去了？”

场子里终于有人笑出声。

沈俊峰脸色挂不住。

他本来是想踩林川几句，没想到林川还没开口，陈怀民先把他摁在了原地。

“陈哥，我就是随口聊两句，没必要这么认真吧。”

“别叫我陈哥。”

陈怀民拿起抹布擦手。

“玩车归玩车，装懂也不是大事。”

“但你装懂，还踩别人，这就没意思了。”

沈俊峰脸色更难看。

“我踩谁了？”

顾城这时候开了口。

“你刚才说外地老板，刚挣了点钱，买法拉利，买大金表。”

他抬手点了点林川那边。

“你说的不会是他吧？”

沈俊峰没接话。

顾城也没打算放过他。

“那我劝你回去问问你爸。”

“张江最近是谁说了算。”

沈俊峰愣住。

张江？

他爸？

这话转得太快，他一时没反应过来。

旁边有人低声提醒。

“九州创投，林川。”

四个字落下。

沈俊峰整个人定住了。

这个名字，他当然听过。

最近家里吃饭，他父亲提过不止一次。

张江那边新起的产业链项目，九州创投是核心操盘方。

研发楼改造，配套材料，园区施工，后续供应商名单，全都绕不开九州。

他父亲做建材，这半年都在想办法挤进张江配套名录。

饭桌上还特意叮嘱过他。

“上海最近有个年轻人，叫林川。”

“遇见了一定客气点。”

“人家一句话，你爸这半年全白跑。”

沈俊峰当时还嫌父亲啰嗦。

现在，林川就站在他面前。

Shen Junfeng's smile froze on his face.

Chen Huaimin stood next to the silver Porsche, holding coffee in his hand.

"Come on, let's talk."

The voices in the field dropped.

Just now Shen Junfeng talked too much.

Engine, chassis, tuning, heritage.

Now Chen Huaimin only asked for a turbine model, which was enough to save him face.

Shen Junfeng stood beside the car, his throat moving.

"993TUrbOS, twin turbos..."

Chen Huaimin nodded.

"No need to talk nonsense. Turbine model."

Shen Junfeng was stuck.

Some people drank coffee while others simply put out their cigarettes.

Gu Cheng leaned against a Bentley, holding back his laughter until his shoulders moved.

Shen Junfeng held on for a few seconds.

"This kind of old car has many configurations, and the European version and the American version are different. There is no need to dig into it in such detail, right?"

Chen Huaimin put the coffee on the tool table.

"Didn't you just say that yourself?"

He patted the roof of the car.

"To really understand cars, you have to talk about engines, chassis, and tuning."

"Now I ask you about Turbo, you talk to me about the version."

"Young Master Shen, where did your inheritance go?"

Someone finally laughed out loud.

Shen Junfeng couldn't help but look worried.

He originally wanted to step on Lin Chuan, but before Lin Chuan could speak, Chen Huaimin pinned him down.

"Brother Chen, I'm just chatting casually, there's no need to be so serious."

"Don't call me Brother Chen."

Chen Huaimin picked up the rag and wiped his hands.

"Playing with cars is all about playing with cars, and it's not a big deal to pretend to understand."

"But if you pretend to understand and step on others, it's boring."

Shen Junfeng's face turned even more ugly.

"Who did I step on?"

Gu Cheng spoke at this time.

"You just said that the out-of-town boss just made some money and bought a Ferrari and a big gold watch."

He raised his hand and pointed at Lin Chuan.

"You're not talking about him, are you?"

Shen Junfeng didn't answer.

Gu Cheng had no intention of letting him go.

"Then I advise you to go back and ask your dad."

"Who has the final say in Zhang Jiang these days?"

Shen Junfeng was stunned.

Zhangjiang?

His dad?

The words passed so quickly that he didn't react for a moment.

Someone next to me reminded him in a low voice.

"Jiuzhou Venture Capital, Lin Chuan."

Four words fell.

Shen Junfeng froze.

Of course he had heard of this name.

His father mentioned it more than once during the recent dinner at home.

Jiuzhou Venture Capital is the core operator of new industrial chain projects in Zhangjiang.

The renovation of the R&D building, supporting materials, park construction, and follow-up supplier list all cannot avoid Jiuzhou.

His father makes building materials and has been trying to get into Zhangjiang's supporting list for the past six months.

I even warned him specifically at the dinner table.

"There is a young man in Shanghai recently named Lin Chuan."

"Be polite when you meet him."

"In one sentence, your dad's work these past six months has been in vain."

Shen Junfeng still thought his father was verbose at the time.

Now, Lin Chuan was standing in front of him.
